title: Pinterest Tag
content:
# Pinterest Tag

Read and create Pinterest tags, manage their custom events, check stats and install them on Shopify or WordPress through the tracking tags API.

import { Tab, Tabs } from 'fumadocs-ui/components/tabs';

Manage Pinterest tags through the platform-neutral [tracking tags API](/guides/pixels) on your `pinterestads` account: read and create tags, manage custom events, check stats and install them.

## Before you start

The connected Pinterest user needs a Business Access role on the ad account (Admin, Analyst, Audience or Campaign). Without one, calls answer `403`.

## Read the tag

`GET .../tracking-tags` lists the tags of every readable ad account. One account refusing access does not hide the others.

`GET .../tracking-tags/{tagId}` adds the tag's `code` (Pinterest's base code), `lastFiredTime` and `installed`.

<Tabs items={['Node.js', 'Python', 'curl']}>
<Tab value="Node.js">
```typescript
const { data } = await zernio.trackingtags.getTrackingTag({
  path: { accountId: '66b2e19d8c3f5a7e9d0b1c2d', tagId: '2612345678901' }
});
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="Python">
```python
data = client.tracking_tags.get_tracking_tag(
    account_id="66b2e19d8c3f5a7e9d0b1c2d",
    tag_id="2612345678901",
)
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="curl">
```bash
curl "https://zernio.com/api/v1/accounts/66b2e19d8c3f5a7e9d0b1c2d/tracking-tags/2612345678901" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY"
```
</Tab>
</Tabs>

Response (`200`):

```json
{
  "platform": "pinterestads",
  "tag": {
    "id": "2612345678901",
    "siteTagId": "2612345678901",
    "name": "Storefront tag",
    "platform": "pinterestads",
    "kind": "tag",
    "status": "active",
    "lastFiredTime": null,
    "installed": false,
    "ownerAdAccountId": "549755885175",
    "code": "<script type=\"text/javascript\">...pintrk('load', '2612345678901');...</script>"
  }
}
```

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| `id` | The numeric Pinterest tag id. It is also what the on-site code loads, so `siteTagId` equals `id`. |
| `adAccountId` | The numeric ad account id. A tag belongs to one ad account; without `adAccountId`, per-tag calls find the owner across every ad account the connection can read. |

`kind` is `tag`.

## Create a tag

`POST .../tracking-tags` takes a name and, optionally, `automaticMatchingFields`.

<Tabs items={['Node.js', 'Python', 'curl']}>
<Tab value="Node.js">
```typescript
const { data } = await zernio.trackingtags.createTrackingTag({
  path: { accountId: '66b2e19d8c3f5a7e9d0b1c2d' },
  body: { adAccountId: '549755885175', name: 'Storefront tag' }
});
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="Python">
```python
data = client.tracking_tags.create_tracking_tag(
    account_id="66b2e19d8c3f5a7e9d0b1c2d",
    ad_account_id="549755885175",
    name="Storefront tag",
)
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="curl">
```bash
curl -X POST "https://zernio.com/api/v1/accounts/66b2e19d8c3f5a7e9d0b1c2d/tracking-tags" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "adAccountId": "549755885175", "name": "Storefront tag" }'
```
</Tab>
</Tabs>

Response (`201`):

```json
{
  "platform": "pinterestads",
  "tag": {
    "id": "2612345678901",
    "siteTagId": "2612345678901",
    "name": "Storefront tag",
    "platform": "pinterestads",
    "kind": "tag",
    "status": "active",
    "lastFiredTime": null,
    "installed": false,
    "ownerAdAccountId": "549755885175",
    "code": "<script type=\"text/javascript\">...pintrk('load', '2612345678901');...</script>"
  }
}
```

`automaticMatchingFields` switches on automatic enhanced match for those fields (`em`, `ph`, `fn`, `ln`, `ct`, `st`, `zp`, `country`, `external_id`, ...).

Create is the only time Zernio can set it, because Pinterest cannot edit a tag afterwards.

<Callout type="warn">The create is not idempotent: a retry creates a second tag. Pinterest has no delete, so never retry it blindly.</Callout>

## Tag operations

| Operation | Behavior |
|-----------|----------|
| Stats (`GET .../stats`) | No time range (`startTime`/`endTime` answer `400`). Rows: the tag (`lastFiredTime`, `status`, `enhancedMatchStatus`), the events Pinterest has seen on it (`page_visit` and `ocpm_eligible` sources, with the matching `siteEvent`), and the ad account's Event Quality Score for the last 1 and 14 days. An account Pinterest cannot score yet reports why in its row. |
| Update | `501`: API v5 lists only `POST` and `GET` on `/conversion_tags` and `GET` on `/conversion_tags/{id}` (`PATCH` and `PUT` on `/conversion_tags/{id}` answer `405`); rename a tag or change enhanced match in Pinterest Ads Manager. |
| Share | `501`: a tag belongs to one ad account and v5 has no sharing endpoint; use Pinterest Business Access. |
| Conversion events (`.../events`) | Pinterest's advertiser defined events: a custom event name the site sends, mapped to a standard type. List, create (`name` plus `type` or `siteEvent`), update (only the type: the name is the event's id, so it cannot be renamed) and delete (Pinterest stops tracking it, `state: "disabled"`). They belong to the ad account, so every tag of that account lists the same ones. At most 15 per ad account, names of 1 to 100 letters, digits, `_` or `-`, case-insensitive. `type` is one of Pinterest's optimizable types (`CHECKOUT`, `ADD_TO_CART`, `LEAD`, `SIGNUP`, `PAGE_VISIT`, ...). |
| Diagnostics, users and partners | `501`. |
| Delete | Not offered: `DELETE /conversion_tags/{id}` answers `405` at Pinterest. |
| Install | Shopify and WordPress. WordPress gets Pinterest's base code with `pintrk('page')` and a `pagevisit` event (official fallback: **Pinterest for WooCommerce**, WooCommerce stores only). Shopify sends every [storefront event](/platforms/shopify/tracking-pixels#event-mapping) to `ct.pinterest.com/v3/`, the endpoint Pinterest's noscript tag and `core.js` use, with `core.js`'s parameter names, the `epik` click id kept in `_epik` and `event_id` set for dedup with the Conversions API. |

Install targets: a connected [Shopify](/platforms/shopify/tracking-pixels) store or [WordPress](/platforms/wordpress/tracking-pixels) site.

## How it behaves

- **Renaming an event** means creating the new name and deleting the old one, because Pinterest keys advertiser defined events by name.
- **Firing an event.** A site fires one with `pintrk('track', '<name>')`, and [`POST /v1/events`](/platforms/pinterest-ads/conversions) matches it by `eventName`.

## If it fails

| Error | Cause | Fix |
|-------|-------|-----|
| `403` | The Pinterest user lacks a Business Access role on the ad account | Grant Admin, Analyst, Audience or Campaign access in Pinterest Business Access. |
| `400` on stats | `startTime` or `endTime` sent | Drop them: tag stats take no time range. |
| `501` on an update | Pinterest's API cannot edit a tag | Rename it or change enhanced match in Pinterest Ads Manager. |
| A second tag after a retry | The create is not idempotent | List the tags after a timeout instead of retrying. |

## Related

- [Pixels and tracking tags](/guides/pixels): the tag API across platforms.
- [Send a conversion event](/platforms/pinterest-ads/conversions): server-side events that dedup against the tag.
- [Shopify tracking pixels](/platforms/shopify/tracking-pixels): the storefront install.
